Vision Government Solutions

|

SALEM,CT

|

Welcome

The Town of Salem has contracted with Vision
Government Solutions of Hudson, Massachusetts to assist with the 2026 state
mandated revaluation project. Data Mailer Questionnaires are in the process of being created and will be sent to the owners of all Residential properties in the Town of Salem.

To ensure public confidence, property owners must play an active and
important role in monitoring the quality of the data that is to be used as the
basis of the Revaluation. Certain information
concerning your property has been compiled from the existing Town Records
and property inspections. This information will be utilized during the
valuation phase of this revaluation process.

Both the Assessor's Office and Vision
Government Solutions would like to thank Town of Salem residents for their
patience and cooperation throughout the 2026 Revaluation project.

Shown on this site are assessments of all
taxable and exempt properties based on 70% of market value as of October 1, 2021.
The previous assessments were as of October 1, 2016.

Please
note that assessed values do not reflect any exemptions, which will be applied
to the final assessments.
